seen_animation: A line-drawn eye: an almond lid outline, a loose looping iris circle, and a small hexagon pupil with a tick at its upper-left, under a grey hatched brow with grey cheek/lid lines. In a.png frames 1-4 the hexagon sits upper-right inside the iris at full size. In frames 5-7 it shrinks to a small speck while drifting slightly left and down. In frame 8 it reappears at full or larger size at the lower-left of the iris, and frames 9-16 hold it there, with the tick now drawn as a larger quadrilateral overlapping the hexagon's left side. The whole eye shifts slightly left and down between frames 7 and 9.
seen_film: An extreme close-up of a human eye in dark shadow under a bushy brow. In d.png frames 1-2 a bright light patch sits at the upper-right of the dark eye. From frame 3 to frame 7 it shrinks to a faint small dot. In frame 8 a larger bright patch appears at the lower-left of the eye, and frames 9-16 hold it there while the framing settles slightly lower and left.
